gloss: to investigate thoroughly, to think through completely

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めませんでした

forms.negative: {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めていなかった

forms.negative: {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to investigate thoroughly, to pursue to the end
definitions.explanation: To examine or investigate something exhaustively until reaching a conclusion.

definitions.gloss: to think through completely, to carry to its logical conclusion
definitions.explanation: To follow a line of reasoning to its ultimate conclusion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{詰|つ}めて⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I investigated the cause of the problem thoroughly.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: When you think it through completely, there's only one answer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{詰|つ}めて⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: As you pursue the theory to its end, contradictions become visible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{詰|つ}める⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: I won't give up until I get to the bottom of the truth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{詰|つ}めて、⟦ついに→遂に：02360_tsuini⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I pursued the culprit thoroughly and finally found the evidence.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めれば、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集約|しゅうやく}→集約：14664_shuuyaku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you get right down to it, the problems all come down to one thing.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Compound verb: ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ + ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧.

PATTERN: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}き{詰|つ}める (pursue/investigate X thoroughly)

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN: ～⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ compounds indicate doing something exhaustively or to completion:
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{詰|つ}める→考え詰める：29484_kangaetsumeru⟧ (to think exhaustively - rare)
- ⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}める→追い詰める：14311_oitsumeru⟧ (to corner, to drive into a corner)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (think through thoroughly)
- {突|つ}き{詰|つ}めれば (ultimately, when you get down to it)
- {突|つ}き{詰|つ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ (in the final analysis)
